notes: Homonym check (cross-reference flagged by Strong's own entry, "See H539"): shares consonants אמן with H539 ("believe; support"), a very common, separate root already in this dataset -- the identical surface form תַאֲמִינוּ could morphologically belong to either root's hiphil. Resolved in favor of H541 ("turn to the right"): the corpus's own lemma tagging assigns this specific occurrence to 541, and the context ("...when ye turn to the right hand [תַאֲמִינוּ] or when ye turn to the left [תַשְׂמְאִילוּ], paired verbs of direction) fits "turn right" rather than "believe". Per the root-key superscript convention (lower Strong's number gets ¹), H539 has been retroactively relabeled אמן¹ in this same batch and this root is אמן².
